questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Topple
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Steady."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Topple" means to become less steady and fall down. (अस्थिर होकर लुढ़क जाना)
 
 
• Example: *Don’t add another book to the pile or it will **topple**__ over.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate antonym of "topple" is "steady."
 
• The word "Steady" means to stop yourself/somebody/something from moving, shaking or falling; to stop moving, shaking or falling. (किसी को स्थिर करना (किसी को हिलने, काँपने या गिरने न देना); स्थिर होना (न हिलना, काँपना या गिरना))
 __
 
• Example: *He had to **steady**__ his nerves/voice before beginning his speech.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Plunge: **to jump, drop or fall suddenly and with force. (अचानक ज़ोरों से छलाँग लगाना, गिरना या गिर जाना, डुबकी लगाना)
 
• **Fumble: **to try to find or take hold of something with your hands in a nervous or careless way. (परेशानी की हालत में या लापरवाही से कुछ ढूँढ़ने या पकड़ने की कोशिश करना; टटोलना)
 
• **Tumble: **to fall down suddenly but without serious injury. ((लड़खड़ाकर) एकाएक गिर पड़ना (बिना अधिक चोट खाए))

**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

The survival of theatre has depended on the creation of ______ formats.
questions.solution:

• The reason is that **"new"** is the appropriate adjective to describe the creation of formats, indicating that these formats are recent or modern, contributing to the survival of theatre.
 
• **"New"** in this context doesn't necessarily compare the formats to others; it simply emphasizes that the creation of formats, regardless of how they compare to each other, has been essential.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: *The survival of theatre has depended on the creation of **new**__ formats.*

questions.question:
**Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To get under one's skin
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"To anger or irritate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The words **"anger"** and **"irritate"** both describe actions that cause negative emotions, but they differ in intensity and duration. (शब्द **"Anger"** और **"Irritate"** दोनों उन कार्यों का वर्णन करते हैं जो नकारात्मक भावनाओं का कारण बनते हैं, लेकिन वे तीव्रता और अवधि में भिन्न होते हैं।)
 
• **"Anger"** is a strong emotion involving a sense of displeasure or hostility. It often arises in response to a perceived injustice, wrongdoing, or frustration. (एक प्रबल भावना जिसमें अप्रसन्नता या शत्रुता की भावना शामिल हो। यह अक्सर कथित अन्याय, गलत कार्य या हताशा की प्रतिक्रिया में उत्पन्न होता है)
 
• **"Irritate"** refers to the act of provoking mild annoyance or provoking a slight feeling of discomfort. It is generally less intense than anger and may result from minor annoyances. (हल्की झुंझलाहट भड़काने या थोड़ी असुविधा की भावना पैदा करने का कार्य। यह आम तौर पर क्रोध से कम तीव्र होता है और छोटी-मोटी परेशानियों का परिणाम हो सकता है)
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

questions.question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

The baby's faces are expressionless and/ their pupils aren't visible which gives/ the appearance of lifelessness and dreadfulness.

options.text: The baby's faces are expressionless and
the appearance of lifelessness and dreadfulness.
their pupils aren't visible which gives

questions.solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** ****"The baby's faces are expressionless and " .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• ​The original sentence uses 'faces', indicating that it refers to multiple entities. 
 
• To match this plural subject, the possessive form "babies' '" should be used.
 
• As per the rule of subject- verb agreement, the verb "are" should agree with the plural subject.
 
• Therefore, to make the sentence grammatically correct, we need to use the 'babies'' instead of 'baby's'

Correct sentence: The babies' face are expressionless and their pupils aren't visible which gives the appearance of lifelessness and dreadfulness.

• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *I have been on this project since the first day, hence I am responsible **for**__ it.*

• **Example**: She is going to the store.
 
• **Example**: This letter is addressed to John.
 
• **Example**: I gave the book to my friend.
 
 
 
• **From: **Indicates the point of origin or starting point.
 
 
• **Example**: I received a gift from my parents.
 
• **Example**: The train is coming from London.
 
• **Example**: The email is from my colleague.
 
 
 
• **By: **Used to indicate the method, means, or agent of doing something.
 
 
• **Example**: The report was written by the team.

questions.question:
